HP:0000951.label: Abnormality of the skin
HP:0000951.text: reduced trypsin-like and chymotrypsin-like proteolytic activity in stratum corneum

records.label: One familial and two sporadic cases with KLK11 Gly50 variants

phenotypes.text: reduced trypsin-like and chymotrypsin-like proteolytic activity in stratum corneum

quotes: We identified two heterozygous variants affecting Gly50 in kallikrein-related peptidase (KLK)11 in a familial case and two sporadic cases with the new disorder, which is characterized by early-onset ichthyosiform erythroderma or erythrokeratoderma.
Consistently, the patients showed a thickened, dense SC, indicating abnormal skin desquamation.
records.genotype_reason: single heterozygous variant; mode as stated for the family

notes.statement: Takeichi et al. (2023) described KLK11-related ichthyosis as a distinct autosomal dominant disorder of cornification, characterized by large hyperkeratotic pigmented plaques on the trunk.
quotes: KLK11 ichthyosis: large truncal hyperkeratotic pigmented plaques underscore a distinct autosomal dominant disorder of cornification.

notes.statement: In 3 families (1 familial and 2 sporadic cases) with a previously undescribed autosomal dominant cornification disorder characterized by early-onset ichthyosiform erythroderma or erythrokeratoderma, Gong et al. (2023) used whole-exome sequencing to identify 2 heterozygous variants affecting Gly50 in KLK11, located around the signal peptide cleavage site, including c.149G>A (p.Gly50Glu).
quotes: Whole-exome sequencing was performed in three families with the novel cornification disorder to identify the disease-causing variants.
We identified two heterozygous variants affecting Gly50 in kallikrein-related peptidase (KLK)11 in a familial case and two sporadic cases with the new disorder

notes.statement: Gong et al. (2023) found in overexpression systems that the KLK11 variants perturbed signal peptide cleavage, leading to subcellular mislocalization and impaired extracellular secretion of the Gly50Glu variant. Patients' stratum corneum showed significantly decreased trypsin-like and chymotrypsin-like proteolytic activity, reduced proteolysis of desmoglein-1, and delayed degeneration of corneodesmosomes, indicating delayed desquamation.
quotes: In vitro experiments demonstrated that the variants perturbed the SP cleavage of KLK11, leading to subcellular mislocalization and impaired extracellular secretion of the KLK11 Gly50Glu variant.

Both trypsin-like and chymotrypsin-like proteolytic activities were significantly decreased in the patients' SC samples. Reduced proteolysis of desmoglein 1 and delayed degeneration of CDs were detected in patients' SC, indicating delayed skin desquamation.

notes.statement: Gong et al. (2023) found that mice homozygous for the Klk11 c.131G>A (p.Gly44Glu) variant, equivalent to human KLK11 p.Gly50Glu, exhibited hyperkeratosis and abnormal desquamation, partially recapitulating the human phenotype.
quotes: Mice harbouring the homozygous c.131G>A (p.Gly44Glu) Klk11 variant, which is equivalent to KLK11 c.149G>A (p.Gly50Glu) in humans, exhibited hyperkeratosis and abnormal desquamation, partially recapitulating the phenotype.
